headline: Asian Stocks Rally as Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia CEO Role
summary: Asian shares surged following a Wall Street rally after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, helping revive the battered artificial intelligence trade.
why: Nvidia is a dominant global semiconductor designer whose market valuation and leadership decisions heavily influence technology sector sentiment worldwide.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Reinstating a key visionary leader restores investor confidence in the company's strategic direction.
